title: Triangular equations generate the evaluation kernel of a finite algebraic tower
statement: Let k and K be fields [def-weil-field] with a k-algebra structure [def-pc-field-extension]. Let x : Fin(d) → K be a transcendence basis [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis], and let b : Fin(m) → K be any finite family, not necessarily generating K. There exist a nonzero h in k[X_0,...,X_{d-1}] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], monic p_i in k[X_0,...,X_{d+i}][Z], and y : Fin(d+1+m) → K such that y_j = x_j for j<d, y_d = h(x)^{-1}, and y_{d+1+i} = b_i. The kernel of the evaluation k-algebra map at y [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] is exactly the ideal generated by triangularFieldModelEquations(k,d,m,h,p) [def-weil-pbc-triangular-field-model-equations, def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. No fraction representation of arbitrary elements of K is claimed.

proof.text: Use the monic normal-form theorem to obtain injective quotient coordinates over k(x) and the evaluation sum formula. For q in the evaluation kernel, that sum is zero. Fintype.linearIndependent_iffₛ makes every coordinate zero; injectivity forces the quotient class of q to vanish, hence q is in the ideal by Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_triangularFieldModel_evaluation_kernel
    (k : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → K) (hx : IsTranscendenceBasis k x)
    (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → K) :
    ∃ (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
      (p : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
      (y : Fin (d + 1 + m) → K),
      h ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ i, (p i).Monic) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin d, y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ = x j) ∧
      y ⟨d, by omega⟩ = (MvPolynomial.aeval x h)⁻¹ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, y ⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ = b i) ∧
      RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval y).toRingHom =
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p)
